notes:
Lead profile: small NYC-based edtech startup building an in-classroom assistant that suggests hints, scaffolded prompts, and auto-summarizes teacher notes. Very price sensitive — unit economics matter. Currently using a mix of open-source models via hosted instances; wants to move to managed hosted API for simplicity and to avoid infra ops. Primary needs: low friction self-serve onboarding, predictable per-token pricing, and a reliable moderation endpoint to filter student-generated content (explicit language, PII).

Pain points / quotes: 
- "We need something that just works out of the box for the classroom — no ops team to babysit models." — Priya, CTO.
- Concerned about cost spikes during heavy student activity; asking about burst limits and throttling.

Technical targets: 
- Workload: chat-based copilot (short multi-turn), real-time hints, and nightly batch embedding indexing for search.
- Latency target: p50 < 300ms for short prompts; p95 < 800ms during normal load. Throughput target: peaks ~30 QPS across 2000 daily active students.
- Model preference: open/llama-family variants welcome; will accept Redwood-curated smaller-gen models if quality ok. Wants fallback routing to cheaper variant during peak.

Security/compliance: SOC2 is a must; SSO (SAML) preferred for admin portal; retention and audit logging required for teacher/admin review. Not asking for on-prem or VPC at this stage.

POC ask: spin up moderation endpoint on hosted API, run 7-day sample with customer prompts, return summary of false positives/negatives. Customer will trial with 2 classrooms (approx 60 students) during April pilot.

Next actions: 
- AE to send tailored low-tier pricing sheet + trial instructions (Ethan) (Due 2026-03-07).
- SE Maya to provide moderation benchmark snippet and small sample script for ingestion.
- Customer to register test app and begin trial; legal to review retention policy.

Sticks: budget cap ~ $1,500/month for pilot; likely to convert if moderation accuracy > 95% on critical categories and costs predictable.
